rounds.text: Trade-Wings Ltd is undergoing a powerful, structural profitability inflection that backward-looking metrics completely miss. Filed statements confirm a remarkable recent return on equity of 55.4% [E13], which is formally flagged as a positive track record supported by a stellar 3-year median ROE of 35% [E48, E26]. This accelerating profitability represents a dramatic and positive break from historical suppression, evidenced by the sharp upward trajectory from a 5-year median ROE of 2% to a last-year median of 55% [E25, E27]. Furthermore, the company demonstrates strong core asset efficiency by generating a return on assets of 4.28%, successfully outperforming the sector benchmark of 4.24% [E8]. Conceded: [E2], [E4], [E6], [E7], [E9], [E24].

Trade-Wings Ltd trades at an extreme valuation that is completely unsupported by its fundamental performance, evidenced by a trailing P/E of 158x [E1] and a sector-relative P/E of 77.68x against a benchmark of just 28.98x [E6]. This lofty pricing is further magnified by a price-to-book ratio of 79.65x [E2] that spikes as high as 101.85x compared to a sector benchmark of 9.82x [E7]. Investors are paying these astronomical multiples for a business that offers a 0.00% dividend yield [E4] and sits 69% of the way up its volatile 52-week range [E5]. Beneath the high price tag lies a deeply troubled long-term track record, punctuated by a disastrous 10-year median ROE of -9% [E24] and a severe 5-year median ROE of only 2% [E25]. Compounding these structural weaknesses, the company's current ROE plummets to -26.14% against a sector benchmark of 11.2% [E9], highlighting that the current market capitalization of ₹ 178 Cr [E3] is divorced from economic reality. Conceded: the company displays a strong recent 3-year median ROE of 35% [E26], a last-year ROE of 55% [E27], and an ROA of 4.28% that slightly edges out the sector benchmark of 4.24% [E8].

Conceded: [E1], [E2], [E4], [E5], [E6], [E7], [E9], [E24], and [E25]. The bear focuses heavily on historical drags, but the enterprise has undergone a powerful structural inflection validated by filed statements showing a stellar current ROE of 55.4% [E13] and a matching last-year median ROE of 55% [E27]. This dramatic turnaround is anchored by a rapidly compounding 3-year median ROE of 35% [E26] that earned the business a formal positive flag for its return on equity track record [E48]. Furthermore, asset utilization has flipped into a competitive advantage, with the company delivering an ROA of 4.28% that successfully outpaces the sector benchmark of 4.24% [E8]. Valuing this company strictly through the lens of distressed historical medians completely misses this explosive, confirmed operational momentum.
